description.en:
Forces the match flow into a given state. The match runs as a sequence of numbered states (kick-off, play, restarts, end...). This call posts a request, and on its next update the match switches to the given state instead of the one it would have chosen.
State numbers seen in the engine: 29 for a kick-off and 8 for a placed restart (both used by CMND_BTL_SET_MATCH_RESTART), 33 for the end of the match (used by CMND_BTL_END_MATCH). The meaning of the other numbers was not mapped.
The only shipped use is SET_NEXT_STATE(22) in btl0003.nut, at the end of a scripted beat, after clearing the on-screen objective.
Match state number to switch to (see above).

true once the request is posted.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: End of a scripted beat (real usage, from btl0003.nut)
